summary.tldr: Excludes certain public institutions from Canada’s bankruptcy and creditor-protection laws.
what_it_does: Changes the Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act so some public institutions are not treated as corporations under that law.
Changes the Companies’ Creditors Arrangement Act so some public institutions are not treated as companies under that law.
Defines the excluded public institutions as ones that receive government operating grants and are subject to federal or provincial rules on governance, accountability, finance and administration.
summary.background: The bill amends the Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act and the Companies’ Creditors Arrangement Act by narrowing who those laws apply to.
